source_text.body:
Build and launch a website with payments on a custom domain
The author built a full website with Claude Code and deployed it on a custom domain via Vercel, with a Stripe payment button, Resend email and a Supabase database.
·
Nov 3, 2026
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
Daria Cupareanu built a consulting-business demo site from the Claude desktop app's Code tab, not the terminal, using auto-accept edits mode. After a first prompt, Claude asked her questions and built the site. She then connected Supabase, Stripe, Resend, GitHub and Vercel with keys and accounts, and Claude also handled SEO, analytics and legal pages. The detailed prompts are behind a paywall.
How it went
The article says the result is a live custom-domain site with a Stripe payment button, a contact form and a lead magnet that delivers itself. It gives no timings or metrics, and the step-by-step detail is paywalled.
Worth knowing
You need a Claude Pro plan ($20/month) and a domain (about $10-20/year). The author says the other tools' free tiers are enough to start.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Help me build a website for [describe your project or business] and get it live on my domain [yourdomain.com] using Vercel. Include a Stripe payment button for [product and price], Resend for confirmation emails, and a Supabase database to store [orders or signups]. Use test mode first, tell me which API keys and settings I need to add myself, and pause for my approval before any deployment or live payment setup.
Original source: https://aiblewmymind.substack.com/p/build-complete-website-claude-code
